title: Python OOP Basics
intro: Python OOP interview questions for freshers are about the four pillars — encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction — but interviewers want you to explain them in Python terms, not generic CS textbook terms. This page covers the class and object model (class as a blueprint, object as an instance), the __init__ constructor and the self parameter (why it's explicit in Python, not implicit like this in Java), encapsulation with single and double underscore conventions, single and multiple inheritance with method resolution order (MRO) explained simply, polymorphism through method overriding and duck typing, and abstract classes with the abc module. Every answer uses a short, complete Python snippet — a BankAccount class or an Animal hierarchy — not a Spring controller or a Java-style boilerplate dump.
